To validate the reliability of automatic evaluation for Generation QA, we conduct human evaluation through pairwise test. Specifically, we first randomly sample 100 pairs of reasoning sentences from two candidate models. And we then involve three independent annotators (undergraduate students uninvolved in this work) to compare reasoning sentences generated by two models (A and B) for the same image-caption pair.
